games.desc:
Play 180 challenging and unique stages with varying difficulty — this obby starts simple but quickly becomes intense, hard, and for almost everyone, unbeatable. Expect rage. Expect to fail. Almost nobody has what it takes to master every tower.

Built as a difficulty chart obby (DCO), VERY DIFFICULT OBBY blends precision parkour, tricky platformer sections, wraparound obstacle courses, and brutal hell lava stages into one impossible gauntlet. Each obstacle pushes harder than the last... how far can you climb before the obby breaks you?

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
